clips.name: establish
clips.prompt:
The red-haired woman sitting on the fallen tree slowly lifts her head, brushes a strand of hair back from her face, and looks off to the side.
No music, no voices, only quiet jungle ambience and birdsong.

clips.name: turn_back
clips.prompt:
The woman keeps looking to the side, then slowly turns her head back towards the camera and settles.
No music, no voices, only quiet jungle ambience and birdsong.

clips.name: stand_up
clips.prompt:
The woman pushes herself up off the fallen tree and stands, steadying herself on a branch.
No music, no voices, only footsteps and rustling leaves.
